channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Matthew Dellavedova | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Matthew Dellavedova from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Matthew Dellavedova
item.description:
“He's right up there with Delly (Matthew Dellavedova). Just guys all for the team, whatever you need, no problem. Great in the locker room, great with the younger guys. It's never about him. It's always about the team and whatever we need. He's unbelievable.”

Tyronn Lue on Matthew Dellavedova, Dec 10, 2025. Source: Responsible Gaming.

item.title: Draymond Green on Matthew Dellavedova
item.description:
“I don’t think MJ had many guys that went through that. [Matthew Dellavedova] stinks,”

Draymond Green on Matthew Dellavedova, Sep 10, 2025. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Andrew Bogut on Matthew Dellavedova
item.description:
podcast, Bogut said Sacramento could use someone like Dellavedova, noting that he has a previous relationship with Kings coach Mike Brown.

“I heard Matthew Dellavedova is being considered to sign with the Sacramento Kings,”

Andrew Bogut on Matthew Dellavedova, Jul 21, 2022. Source: Fresno Bee.

item.title: Patty Mills on Andrew Bogut, Joe Ingles, Aron Baynes, Matthew Dellavedova
item.description:
Mills says, before repeating himself.

“I don't say that necessarily as a good thing. We definitely have got some work to do in this area, I believe, but for now it's full focus on Tokyo,and a gold medal would do wonders for our program, as at least a starting point. There's a prestigious feeling within our program that needs to be a joint effort between the playing group and Basketball Australia to make sure when -- we've lost 'Bogues' [Andrew Bogut], obviously -- I step away, when Joe Ingles steps away, 'Delly' [Matthew Dellavedova], [Aron] Baynes -- that that program is still elite, if not even more levels up, as it should be.”

Patty Mills on Andrew Bogut, Joe Ingles, Aron Baynes, Matthew Dellavedova, Jan 13, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Matthew Dellavedova
item.description:
“And he’s an unselfish dude and a hard worker. All of those things -- personality traits, character and skill set -- is what we took into account. Delly (Matthew Dellavedova) played with him. Dre played with him. We had guys who had first-hand knowledge of what kind of person he was and that impacts our decision.”

JB Bickerstaff on Matthew Dellavedova, Dec 7, 2020. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Matthew Dellavedova
item.description:
Casey on Delly:

“He's not in our minds. I didn't go to bed thinking about Dellavedova”

Dwane Casey on Matthew Dellavedova, Apr 17, 2017. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Andrew Bogut on Matthew Dellavedova
item.description:
Warriors center Andrew Bogut explained his cryptic tweet about the play that left teammate Andre Iguodala injured by asking a question.

“What do you think if a different guy did that like a (Matthew) Dellavedova?”

Andrew Bogut on Matthew Dellavedova, Mar 15, 2016. Source: Contra Costa Times.

item.title: David Griffin on JR Smith, Matthew Dellavedova
item.description:
David Griffin on the free agency of J.R. Smith and Matthew Dellavedova:

“We’d like to bring both of them back if it can be worked out. In Delly’s case the restricted free agency is a totally different process. With J.R. … he’s a player I’d like to have back. We just have to find a way to make it work.”

David Griffin on JR Smith, Matthew Dellavedova, Jul 13, 2015. Source: Akron Beacon Journal.

item.title: Mychal Thompson on Stephen Curry, Matthew Dellavedova
item.description:
Diamond Leung:Mychal Thompson on Matthew Dellavedova:

“He's trying his little heart out, but come on. It's a joke to think he can stop Steph Curry.”

Mychal Thompson on Stephen Curry, Matthew Dellavedova, Jun 11, 2015. Source: Twitter @diamond83.

item.title: Draymond Green on Matthew Dellavedova
item.description:
Diamond Leung:Draymond on Matthew Dellavedova:

“He's been getting every loose ball & that's something that we have to change. I take that upon myself.”

Draymond Green on Matthew Dellavedova, Jun 10, 2015. Source: Twitter @diamond83.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Matthew Dellavedova
item.description:
“I mean, that shot [Matthew Dellavedova] hit when we were down one when Steph fouled him, that was just lucky, man,”

Klay Thompson on Matthew Dellavedova, Jun 10, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Matthew Dellavedova
item.description:
Chris Fedor:#Cavs Kyrie Irving on Matthew Dellavedova:

“I'm definitely not surprised. First time I played against him he commanded my respect”

Kyrie Irving on Matthew Dellavedova, Jun 10, 2015. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Andrew Bogut on Matthew Dellavedova
item.description:
Ethan J. Skolnick:Andrew Bogut on his friend & countryman Matthew Dellavedova:

“I don't think he's a dirty player. I think he's a gritty a------ of a player.”

Andrew Bogut on Matthew Dellavedova, Jun 6, 2015. Source: Twitter @EthanJSkolnick.

item.title: Andrew Bogut on Matthew Dellavedova
item.description:
Dellavedova was left sitting on the shelf, bypassed by all 30 NBA teams, and star centre Bogut, who arrived at the Warriors the year before in a controversial multi-player trade, had a chat with Golden State general manager Bob Myers.

“I was trying to get him (Dellavedova) here actually, but we didn't have a roster spot at the time,”

Andrew Bogut on Matthew Dellavedova, May 31, 2015. Source: Sydney Morning Herald.

item.title: DeMarre Carroll on Matthew Dellavedova
item.description:
Steve Aschburner:Carroll on Aussie Dellavedova:

“I don't even know – he's a foreigner, can he speak English? Oh, OK. I probably wouldn't say nothing.”

DeMarre Carroll on Matthew Dellavedova, May 27, 2015. Source: Twitter @AschNBA.

item.title: Al Horford on Matthew Dellavedova
item.description:
“But with (Dellavedova's) track record, I just felt like it was. And again, on my part it was very, very poor judgement.”

Al Horford on Matthew Dellavedova, May 25, 2015. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.
